What Alinia AI sells

  • Alinia Judges: Models trained to judge outputs against institutional and legal policies.
  • Guardrails API: Applies policy checks while AI systems are running.
  • AI Compliance Platform: Expert review and audit records support deployment into live use.
  • Seny: A specialized legal-compliance model released in October 2026.
